To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of AI in a multi-agent MDT context can enhance security, while MTD can enhance security of the present AI algorithms.

MTD systems are more secure when the attacker and defender have an adversarial relationship, MTD can be used to address the security concerns of AI, and there are several challenges for the AI research community to address in the context of MTD systems.

(1) MTD systems are a promising technique for enhancing security of AI algorithms; (2) AI techniques can enhance the security of a multi agent MTD system; and (3) MTD systems can be used for enhancing security of the present day algorithms of AI.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) Enhancing security of MTD by using AI techniques, and (2) Using the principles of MTD to enhance the security and privacy of AI algorithms.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AI can be used to enhance security of AI systems.
AI and Security are not two separate domains, but are symbiotic and can benefit each other.
AI is a powerful tool for enhancing security of systems and MTD is an effective technique for enhancing security of AI algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MTD systems are a good example of how AI and Security can work in a symbiotic relationship to address the security concerns of modern day applications.
MTD can be an effective technique to enhance the security and robustness of AI algorithms.
the AI community should be aware of the security concerns of their algorithms and the cyber security community should be aware that AI techniques can be used to enhance the security in their systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of AI for enhancing security is symbiotic and not mutually exclusive.
AI can be used for enhancing the security of a multi agent MTD system.
MTD can be applied to AI algorithms to improve the security of the algorithms themselves, in addition to the applications that use them.
